attr.title: Lost Flame
attr.desc: Lost Flame is a modern traditional roguelike with turn-based, positioning-driven melee combat. Explore a ruined kingdom, fight legendary warriors and piece together the cause of the cataclysm, with deep character building through weapons, rings, amulets and enchantments.
attr.inst: Buy Lost Flame on Steam, then copy 'LostFlame.jar' from the game folder into ports/lostflame. First launch patches your copy, which takes well under a minute.
attr.inst_md: Buy Lost Flame [on Steam](https://store.steampowered.com/app/856570/Lost_Flame/), then copy `LostFlame.jar` from the game folder into `ports/lostflame`. First launch patches your copy, which takes well under a minute.
